selectedFunctions.label: Request USTB offchain-settled redemption
warnings: Permissioned fund access only: official onboarding requires fund approval, KYC/AML, signed investment agreement, Qualified Purchaser eligibility in supported countries and fund-specific wallet allowlisting. No capability bypasses issuer eligibility or allowlist checks; this is NOT permissionless.

Upgradeable Ethereum USTB/USCC and redemption proxies are bound to recorded implementation/source evidence, not a fresh RPC identity or execution guarantee. Issuer can pause issuance/accounting/transfers, change configuration, revoke eligibility, upgrade, and force burn under legal circumstances.

USDC means Ethereum mainnet token 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 with 6 decimals; USTB/USCC fund shares use their own units. Prior allowance is required where tokens are pulled; allowance is never granted automatically.

Atomic USTB subscribe reads the configured price oracle and stablecoin configuration, pulls caller USDC, and mints to the recipient. Recipient must be authorized to hold the fund token; docs additionally require eligible approved investors. No user-supplied minimum shares or deadline is present; stale/invalid price, unsupported stablecoin, pause or rounding can revert.

Atomic USTB RedemptionIdle.redeem transfers approved caller USTB, pays USDC, then calls token offchainRedeem. Idle USDC liquidity, oracle checks, fees, token allowlisting/accounting state and redemption pause apply. Arbitrary recipient overload controls USDC destination, not withdrawal authority over another investor.

offchainRedeem burns the caller shares and starts offchain fund settlement to the registered payout destination. It does NOT synchronously transfer USDC. Configure an eligible USDC payout destination if USDC is wanted; USD payout is also possible. USCC official settlement is T+1 before 5pm ET or T+2 after; fund schedules and compliance apply.

USCC inherited subscribe overloads are retained in ABI but excluded: official documentation establishes portal funding and scheduled issuance, not configured atomic USDC subscription support. Issuer mint/bulkMint/adminBurn, signature permit/allowlist authorization, treasury sweep and all bridge paths remain excluded.

USTB and USCC continue as Invesco USTB and Bitwise USCC in current Superstate docs; no retirement notice was encountered in the reviewed product evidence. Fund AUM/whole-protocol TVL and DAU/MAU are not claimed.

Permissioned fund access only: official onboarding requires fund approval, KYC/AML, signed investment agreement, Qualified Purchaser eligibility in supported countries and fund-specific wallet allowlisting. No capability bypasses issuer eligibility or allowlist checks; this is NOT permissionless.

Upgradeable Ethereum USTB/USCC and redemption proxies are bound to recorded implementation/source evidence, not a fresh RPC identity or execution guarantee. Issuer can pause issuance/accounting/transfers, change configuration, revoke eligibility, upgrade, and force burn under legal circumstances.

USDC means Ethereum mainnet token 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 with 6 decimals; USTB/USCC fund shares use their own units. Prior allowance is required where tokens are pulled; allowance is never granted automatically.

Atomic USTB subscribe reads the configured price oracle and stablecoin configuration, pulls caller USDC, and mints to the recipient. Recipient must be authorized to hold the fund token; docs additionally require eligible approved investors. No user-supplied minimum shares or deadline is present; stale/invalid price, unsupported stablecoin, pause or rounding can revert.

Atomic USTB RedemptionIdle.redeem transfers approved caller USTB, pays USDC, then calls token offchainRedeem. Idle USDC liquidity, oracle checks, fees, token allowlisting/accounting state and redemption pause apply. Arbitrary recipient overload controls USDC destination, not withdrawal authority over another investor.

offchainRedeem burns the caller shares and starts offchain fund settlement to the registered payout destination. It does NOT synchronously transfer USDC. Configure an eligible USDC payout destination if USDC is wanted; USD payout is also possible. USCC official settlement is T+1 before 5pm ET or T+2 after; fund schedules and compliance apply.

USCC inherited subscribe overloads are retained in ABI but excluded: official documentation establishes portal funding and scheduled issuance, not configured atomic USDC subscription support.
